summary: Explained load balancer, hashing, caching, indexing, embeddings, and semantic search, then mapped them onto the Ford customer incentive and rewards path: Redis/Memcached hot reads (~30% less database load), idempotent writes, Kubernetes autoscaling, and a structured program-spend forecast within about 5%, with embeddings and semantic search limited to grounded rule lookup rather than calculating awards.
